errors.lastFounder: This is the team's only Founder. Hand over the role to someone else first.
errors.theirLimit: This person is already in 3 teams — that's the maximum per account.
errors.founderGrantOnly: Only a Founder can grant the Founder role.
errors.selfDemote: You can't remove your own Founder role from here. Use “Hand over the Founder role” next to the person you want to give it to.
errors.notMember: You're not a member of this team.
errors.jobTitleOthers: Other people's job titles are changed by the Founder and Admins.
errors.useLeave: To leave the team, use the “Leave team” button.
errors.transferFounderOnly: Only the Founder can hand over the Founder role.
errors.targetNotMember: This person isn't in the team.
errors.tagline: One sentence about the team: at most 160 characters.
errors.logoSize: The logo can be at most 15 MB.
errors.archiveFounderOnly: Only the Founder can move it to the archive.
errors.deleteFounderOnly: Only the Founder can delete the startup.
errors.nameMismatch: The name you typed doesn't match the startup's name.
errors.demoteFailed: The Founder role was granted, but your own role couldn't be changed. The team now has two Founders — change your role manually in the list.
page.noTeamBody: Your team appears here once you create a startup or join someone else's. Until then you have the Social layer.
page.memberNote: Members and roles are changed by the Founder and Admins. Everyone changes their own job title themselves.
page.notHiringTitle: You're not looking for anyone right now
page.roleNote: The role says who can change stages and members. A job title (CEO, CTO) doesn't grant permissions.
page.memberCount: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} in the team.
page.wantToJoin: {count, plural, one {One person wants} other {# people want}} to join.
page.toReassign: {count, plural, one {# item is waiting} other {# items are waiting}} for a new owner — left by someone who left the team.
page.notHiringBody: Add an open role — with hours and skills — and your team will appear in Find a project among those recruiting.
page.seatsLeft: {count, plural, one {# seat left.} other {# seats left.}}
profile.managersOnly: The public profile is edited by the Founder and Admins
profile.managersOnlyBody: You can view it the way people from outside see it.
profile.title: Public profile
profile.subtitle: This is how people looking for a project see you.
delete.body: This can't be undone. All stage answers, open roles, applications and the whole team will disappear.
delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.pauseBefore: If you only want to take a break, choose
delete.pauseAfter: instead of deleting. The startup will disappear from Discover, but everything stays in place.
delete.typeName: Type the startup's name to confirm
link.readyBody: Copy it and send it to someone for the team.
link.revokedBody: Nobody can join through it anymore.
link.copiedBody: Paste it in WhatsApp, Messenger or an email.
link.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the link in the field and copy it manually.
link.title: Invite friends with a link
link.newRevokes: A new link turns off the current one.
link.body: Send the link to anyone — they don't need a Vairo account yet. After signing up or signing in they'll join the team as {role}.
link.validUntil: Valid until {date} · {used} of {max} people have joined through it
nudge.linkUnused: The invitation link is ready, but nobody has joined through it yet. Send it to someone you want to build this with — e.g. on Messenger.
nudge.helpAlone: Help is often closer than it seems. Invite a friend with a link — they don't need a Vairo account yet.
nudge.startAlone: Validation is easier with a few people: someone will ask a question you can't see from the inside. Invite a friend with a link — they don't need a Vairo account yet.
nudge.helpTeam: There {count, plural, one {is # person} other {are # people}} in the team. Missing someone with a specific skill? Add an open role — the team will appear in Discover — or look in “Find people”.
leave.body: You'll lose access to the stages, documents and everything that belongs to this team. What has already been filled in stays with the team.
leave.title: Leave {name}?
leave.freesSeat: This frees one of the {max} seats on your account.
member.noWork: Not leading any open goals or tasks right now.
member.lastFounder: Only Founder — hand over this role to someone else first
member.rolesBody: This is the only place that decides who can change stage data and team members. A job title (CEO, CTO) doesn't grant permissions.
member.work: Leading: {goals, plural, one {# goal} other {# goals}} · {tasks, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}}
member.founderOnly: Only the Founder can grant it.
member.handOverBody: {name} will become the Founder and you an Admin. You'll lose the ability to delete the startup and grant the Founder role.
member.transferBody: {name} will take over leading the team. You'll become an Admin — you still manage members and stages, but you won't be able to delete the startup or grant anyone the Founder role.
member.transferNote: This change can only be reversed if the new Founder gives the role back to you. Do it only after agreeing with that person beforehand.
member.removeBody: {name} will lose access to everything that belongs to this team. What has already been filled in stays.
roles.title: Open roles
roles.emptyManager: You're not looking for anyone right now. Add a role and your team will appear in Discover among those recruiting.
roles.empty: This team has no open roles right now.
roles.deleteWarning: Applications for this role will lose what they refer to
roles.nameRequired: Enter the role name — at least 2 characters
roles.name: Role name
roles.skills: Which skills are you looking for
roles.description: What this person will work on
roles.descriptionPlaceholder: E.g. Building a booking panel in Next.js. The visual design is already done.
roles.noSkills: Without skills this role won't match anyone's profile in Discover.
preview.noRoles: Without open roles the card doesn't say who you're looking for — and that's the only thing a joiner reads on it.
preview.detailsNote: The “About the project” description, team members and tags are visible only on the team profile — one click further.
status.active.label: Active
status.active.description: Normal work. The team can be visible in Discover.
status.paused.label: Paused
status.paused.description: Put aside for later. Doesn't appear in Discover, but everything stays in place.
status.archived.label: Archived
status.archived.description: Idea closed. The data stays, the team disappears from search.
editor.visibleOn: People can find you and send an application. The idea description from the Idea Stage stays private.
editor.visibleOff: You don't appear in search. You can still invite people yourselves.
editor.stageOn: The card shows the stage name. The answers themselves stay in the team.
editor.stageOff: Nobody outside sees how far along you are.
editor.deleteBody: Deleting the startup erases everything: stage answers, open roles, applications and team members. There's no trash and no undo.
editor.saveFirst: Save or discard the profile changes first.
editor.hiddenNote: This card doesn't appear in Discover right now — the team's visibility is turned off.
editor.complete: Complete — the card says everything it should.
editor.logoHint: Square, JPG, PNG or WebP up to 15 MB. Without a logo the card shows the first letter of the name.
editor.taglineHint: This shows on the card in Discover. What you do and for whom.
editor.taglinePlaceholder: e.g. Bookings for small beauty salons
editor.aboutHint: A longer description on the team page — not on the card. As much as you want to show strangers.
editor.aboutPlaceholder: What you're working on, what stage you're at, who you're looking for and what you expect.
editor.advanced: Advanced: status, archiving and deleting the team
errors.hours: Hours per week: a number from 1 to 80.
preview.taglinePlaceholder: One sentence about you goes here
